payPage.footnote: Secure payment by Stripe. Card details go straight to Stripe.
payPage.loadFailedBody: We can't show where this payment stands right now. If you have already paid, you don't need to pay again. Try again in a moment, or contact {company} if it keeps happening.
payPage.invalidBody: It may have been replaced by a newer one. Ask {company} for a new link.
payPage.caption: Booking {reference}
payPage.intro: Hi {name}, check the details below before you {action, select, extension {agree and pay} deposit {authorise the hold} other {pay}}.

amounts.extensionNote: Charged to your card once you agree to the new return time
amounts.dueNoteDeposit: Charged to your card now. Does not include the deposit.
amounts.holdNote: Held on your card, not charged. Released after the return.
amounts.depositLater: Not part of this payment. {company} arranges it before pick-up.

action.processingBody: Your bank is still confirming the payment. This page updates on its own.

checkout.unavailable: Card payments aren't available right now. Please contact the rental company.
checkout.failed: The payment didn't go through. Check your connection and try again.
checkout.holdFailed: The deposit hold didn't go through.
checkout.resumeHoldFailed: Your payment went through, but the deposit could not be held on the same payment method. Enter a card for the hold.
checkout.resumeEnterCard: Your payment went through. Enter a card for the deposit hold.
checkout.consentPay: By paying, you authorise {company} to hold {deposit} on this card. It is only charged if your rental agreement calls for it, and is released after the return.
checkout.consentHold: {company} holds {deposit} on this card. It is only charged if your rental agreement calls for it, and is released after the return.

paid_and_held.title: You're all set
paid_and_held.body: {company} has your payment of {amount} and holds {deposit} as your deposit for booking {reference}. You can close this page.

paid.title: Payment received
paid.body: {company} has your payment of {amount} for booking {reference}. You can close this page.

paid_deposit_later.title: Payment received
paid_deposit_later.body: {company} has your payment of {amount} for booking {reference}. They will send a separate link for the {deposit} security deposit before pick-up.

paid_deposit_failed.title: Payment received
paid_deposit_failed.body: {company} has your payment of {amount} for booking {reference}. The {deposit} security deposit hold did not go through, so {company} will be in touch about it.

held.title: Deposit on hold
held.body: {company} holds {deposit} on your card for booking {reference}. You can close this page.

extended.title: Your rental is extended
extended.body: {company} has your payment of {amount}, and booking {reference} now runs to the return time shown above. You can close this page.

extension_late.title: The extension didn't go through
extension_late.body: Your payment of {amount} arrived after the request had run out, and the vehicle was no longer free. {company} will refund it and be in touch about booking {reference}.

closed.title: This link is no longer active
closed.body: Ask {company} for a new payment link.

extension.title: Agree to the new return time
extension.name: Full name
extension.namePlaceholder: As it appears on your licence
extension.agree: I agree to return the vehicle by {when} and to pay {amount} for the extension. Every other term of {agreement} continues to apply.
extension.kept: The new return time is kept for you until {when}. It only takes effect once you have paid.
extension.failed: We couldn't record that. Check your connection and try again.
extension.consentRequired: Tick the box to confirm you agree before paying.

receipt.loadFailedBody: Try again in a moment, or contact {company} if it keeps happening.
receipt.unpaidBody: Nothing has been paid on this booking so far. Your receipt appears here once {company} takes a payment.
receipt.caption: Booking {reference}
receipt.title: Receipt

terms.nonRefundable: Non-refundable: if you cancel after paying, nothing is refunded.
terms.ended: Refunds end {when}, so nothing is refunded if you cancel after paying.
terms.endedDays: {count, plural, =1 {1 day} other {# days}} before pick-up
